strings.name: Kendrick Lamar
strings.summary: Raised in Compton, California, Kendrick Lamar released teenage mixtapes as K.Dot before entering the mainstream with good kid, m.A.A.d city. His narrative rap interweaves community life, race, faith and self-questioning, while To Pimp a Butterfly incorporated jazz and funk. DAMN. won the 2018 Pulitzer Prize for Music.
strings.coverageNote: Selected milestones from early mixtapes through the 2026 Grammys, checked through November 13, 2026; award years and release years are stated separately.
strings.influence.rationale: Using narrative rap to discuss race, community and personal identity, he won the Pulitzer Prize for Music for DAMN. and broadened the cultural standing of rap.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Pulitzer Prize for Music
strings.highlights.h1.text: DAMN., released in 2017, won the 2018 Pulitzer Prize for Music.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Conceptual and sonic exploration
strings.highlights.h2.text: Expanded mainstream rap expression through sustained narratives, character perspectives, and jazz and funk elements.
strings.timeline.t1.title: GNX won a Grammy
strings.timeline.t1.text: GNX won best rap album; luther, his collaboration with SZA, shared the record of the year award.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Headlined the Super Bowl halftime show
strings.timeline.t2.text: Headlined the Super Bowl LIX halftime show in New Orleans, joined by guests including SZA.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Released GNX
strings.timeline.t3.text: Released GNX after Mr. Morale & the Big Steppers, continuing his exploration of West Coast rap.
strings.timeline.t4.title: DAMN. won the Pulitzer
strings.timeline.t4.text: Won the music prize for his 2017 album, recognized for its portrayal of contemporary African American life.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Released To Pimp a Butterfly
strings.timeline.t5.text: Brought jazz, funk and multiple narrative voices into an album addressing race, success and personal responsibility.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Broke through with good kid, m.A.A.d city
strings.timeline.t6.text: Built an album narrative around growing up in Compton, drawing broad critical attention and entering the mainstream.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Released his first official album
strings.timeline.t7.text: Released Section.80, developing his early mixtape work into a full album and a broader audience.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Released an early mixtape as K.Dot
strings.timeline.t8.text: Issued his first mixtape at sixteen under the name K.Dot, beginning to build a reputation in the local rap scene.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Born in Compton
strings.timeline.t9.text: Born in Compton, California; community experience later supplied material for his characters, settings and social narratives.
